notes: All 12 views inspected. Small container feeder with a raked bow, anchors and hawse pipes, a pastel container stack, two deck cranes with jibs, hooks and cable runs, a multi-deck accommodation block with bridge glazing, a funnel, lifeboats, mast and radar, and a painted boot-top and antifouling line. The bottom view confirms a complete hull with rudder, propeller and bilge keels rather than a flat cut-off. The propeller is a SEPARATE node, so it can be given a spin clip.

The deck cranes are fused and cannot be slewed without separation.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
